inputs.text: They’re presenting Water Not Coal as a grassroots push to protect southern Alberta’s watershed, with local canvassers collecting signatures for a citizen initiative. But don’t mistake a petition for proof that the people making decisions are on the public’s side. The campaign, started by Corb Lund last month, channels concern into a request for the Government of Alberta to legislate against coal exploration—while the interests shaping the larger fight stay out of view. That’s a convenient way to make people feel heard without showing who actually benefits.
